question: What relationship exists between the eighty-eight thousand multitude and praise by great sages?
premises: There is a multitude of eighty-eight thousand
The deity is bound or encompassed by great sages' praise
The praise relates to that multitude
inference: The deity, associated with an eighty-eight thousand multitude, is encompassed by the praise of great sages.
uncertainties: The exact referent of the eighty-eight thousand multitude is unclear
plain_english: He is the multitude of eighty-eight thousand and is encompassed by the praises of the great sages.
